run.selected_because: Highest report_analysis duration in the latest accepted frozen-five cohort (378.228 seconds).

post_readiness_queue_observation.scope: Post-readiness queue work; separate from this report's validation and readiness result.

critical_path_recommendation.experiment: Run a quality-gated isolated A/B with report_vs/doc_map reasoning effort high -> medium.
critical_path_recommendation.basis: The single doc-map request was 85.918 seconds of provider-active wall time, all 85.918 seconds exclusive of other provider calls, in evidence_pack_primary. It used high effort and 5,817 reasoning tokens.
critical_path_recommendation.quality_guard: Use the same report, input and validation/readiness checks; reject the setting if grounding or editorial quality regresses.

provider_profile.aggregate_provider_work_semantics: sum of per-call elapsed time; not critical-path duration
provider_profile.exclusive_exposed_wall_semantics: group-active intervals with no other provider call active in the report
provider_profile.provider_active_wall_semantics: union of persisted monotonic provider-request intervals
provider_profile.provider_interval_clock_scope: time.monotonic readings in milliseconds; intervals require a shared host clock domain
provider_profile.wall_clock_exposure_ranking_basis: per-prompt-family interval union; families can overlap and are not additive
